scope: Prototype assembly observations; unprinted geometry is not physical fit acceptance.

c14.observation: Height clearance is insufficient in the assembled back-top article.
c14.article_identity_basis: Latest accepted back-top launch found in the repository; the October 11 preparation is recorded as not started. Used as the identified article for comparison, without a serial-number identification claim.
c14.prior_acceptance_scope: The earlier inlet/C13 station acceptance in tee-readiness/full-enclosure-print/hard-contact-review retains its identified-part scope. It does not override this installed-article observation.

cord_access_test_fit.observation: The female side fits; the mating plug body needs 3 mm more X width in the external rounded-rectangle access cavity to reach it.

mean_well.observation: Provide wire space at the terminal ends along the module's long axis.
mean_well.reference_block_dimensions: Representative; exact installed wire bend and terminal-mouth placement are unmeasured.

cold_core.observation: Blind tube insertion below the reservoir is too tight. Passive passages must be larger than the tube.
cold_core.gripping_fits: Use their own part dimensions: faucet, organizer, copper-plug seats and PRV tube socket.

wire.stock_rating: Marked UL1007, 300 V, 80 degrees C; inspect delivered marking.
wire.stranded_runs: C14 solder-tab pigtails, SJOOW compressor cord, pump lead, protective-earth bonds and JST/Faston/removable-display harnesses.

other_agent_review.reviewed_scope: Screw-length and documentation changes; no terminal, C14 or cold-core clearance correction in that commit.
